spans.text:
Do NOT provide any additional context, or your response will not be parsed correctly.
You will NOT get another chance to request files after this!
spans.note: The prompt explicitly removes user agency by stating the system will NOT get another chance to request files and must not provide additional context. The strict format requirement and the instruction 'Do NOT provide any additional context' prevents the system from asking clarifying questions or surfacing options to the user, undermining collaborative interaction.
